stories.title: Nach 57 Minuten stand es 2:5 – 3 Tore binnen 101 Sekunden: Lausanne siegt nach irrem Comeback

en.title: After 57 minutes it was 2:5 – 3 goals in 101 seconds: Lausanne wins after incredible comeback
en.summary: Lausanne was trailing Geneva 2:5 after 57 minutes in the Léman Derby but staged a remarkable comeback to win 6:5 in a penalty shootout.

stories.title: Terrorverdacht nach Zwischenfall auf Flydubai-Flug nach Tel Aviv

en.title: Terror suspicion following incident on Flydubai flight to Tel Aviv
en.summary: A Flydubai aircraft was diverted to Saudi Arabia after a violent altercation in the cockpit, with Israeli authorities investigating whether the co-pilot may have been planning an attack.

stories.title: Women's Champions League – Kantersieg für Schertenleibs Barça – Reuteler und Peng Ersatz

en.title: Women's Champions League – Schertenleib's Barcelona wins by large margin – Reuteler and Peng substitutes
en.summary: Barcelona secured its second consecutive victory in the Champions League group stage, with Sydney Schertenleib playing the full match.

stories.title: Mit 20 zum Tode verurteilt, mit 50 immer noch im Todestrakt: Gericht stoppt historische Hinrichtung im US-Gliedstaat Tennessee

en.title: Sentenced to death at 20, still on death row at 50: Court halts historic execution in US state of Tennessee
en.summary: A Tennessee court halted the scheduled execution of Christa Pike, who had spent 30 years on death row following a 1995 murder conviction, raising broader questions about capital punishment in the United States.

stories.title: Le mastodonte de la musique Live Nation prend pied en France avec la salle où se produit Céline Dion

en.title: Music giant Live Nation enters France with arena hosting Céline Dion
en.summary: Live Nation, an American entertainment company, has completed its first acquisition in France by purchasing the Plenitude Arena near Paris, where Céline Dion currently performs. The purchase reinforces Live Nation's dominant position in the entertainment industry.

stories.title: Neue bilaterale Verträge – EU-Paket soll laut Ständerat Volk und Ständen vorgelegt werden

en.title: New bilateral contracts – EU package should be presented to people and cantons according to Council of States
en.summary: The Swiss Council of States has determined that new EU treaties require approval from both the people and cantons, meaning both votes must pass for the agreements to be ratified.

stories.title: LIVE-TICKER - Ständemehr für die EU-Verträge: Der Ständerat will, dass neben dem Volk auch die Kantone den Bilateralen III zustimmen müssen

en.title: LIVE TICKER – Majority of cantons required for EU treaties: Council of States wants cantons to approve Bilateral III alongside voters
en.summary: The Swiss Council of States is debating new EU treaties and will require approval from both voters and cantons for the bilateral agreements to be implemented.

stories.title: DIE NEUESTEN ENTWICKLUNGEN - Gescheiterte Investorenpläne der Fifa: SFV zieht Unterstützung für Infantino zurück

en.title: Latest developments - FIFA's failed investor plans: SFV withdraws support for Infantino
en.summary: FIFA planned to transfer some commercial rights to private investors but withdrew the proposal in early August. The Swiss Football Association has consequently withdrawn its support for FIFA President Infantino.

stories.title: Nach Neubeurteilung – SFV zieht Unterstützung für Fifa-Präsident Infantino zurück

en.title: After reassessment – SFV withdraws support for FIFA president Infantino
en.summary: The Swiss Football Association has withdrawn its backing for FIFA president Infantino following a reevaluation of recent developments.

stories.title: Fall Christa Pike – Gericht stoppt historische Hinrichtung von Mörderin in Tennessee

en.title: Christa Pike case – Court halts historic execution of Tennessee murderer
en.summary: A court in Tennessee has stopped the execution of Christa Pike, ruling that her concerns regarding the legality of the previous legal proceedings must be reviewed.

stories.title: Der kleinste Soldat Mexikos erobert Herzen und soll bald Leben retten

en.title: Mexico's smallest soldier wins hearts and will soon save lives
en.summary: A Chihuahua named Comando joined Mexico's army after his owners could no longer care for him. He is being trained to work as a search and rescue dog.

stories.title: Kleine Pfoten, grosser Einsatz – Chihuahua-Rekrut Comando erobert Herzen und Mexikos Nationalgarde

en.title: Small paws, big mission – Chihuahua recruit Comando wins hearts and Mexico's National Guard
en.summary: Mexico's National Guard presented an unusually small member of its ranks, a Chihuahua named Comando.

stories.title: Umbauen im Imperium von Peter Spuhler: Nach Stadler Rail tauscht auch Rieter den CEO aus

en.title: Restructuring in Peter Spuhler's empire: After Stadler Rail, Rieter also replaces CEO
en.summary: Rieter's CEO Thomas Oetterli failed to lead the textile machinery manufacturer out of crisis despite significant authority. Major shareholder Peter Spuhler faces critical scrutiny over the changes.

stories.title: China schnürt Europas Industrie die Luft ab: Nun reist der EU-Handelskommissar mit einem kaum erfüllbaren Auftrag nach Peking

en.title: China restricts European industry's room to maneuver: EU trade commissioner heads to Beijing with nearly impossible demands
en.summary: EU Trade Commissioner Maros Sefcovic is pressing China for trade concessions in nearly ultimatum-like terms. Questions remain about how he intends to enforce these demands in negotiations.

stories.title: Kommt jetzt der grosse Aufschwung? Die wichtigsten Fragen und Antworten zur Schweizer Wirtschaft

en.title: Is a major upturn coming? Key questions and answers about the Swiss economy
en.summary: Switzerland's economy is performing surprisingly well, prompting the KOF Institute to raise its forecasts. Economic improvement is also reaching the general population.

stories.title: DIE NEUESTEN ENTWICKLUNGEN - Krise bei Volkswagen: VW kündigt fast alle Tarifverträge

en.title: Latest developments - Volkswagen crisis: VW terminates nearly all collective agreements
en.summary: Volkswagen Group is undergoing major restructuring, planning to eliminate 50,000 additional positions by 2030 across Europe's largest automaker. The company is terminating collective labor agreements.

stories.title: MELDUNGEN WIRTSCHAFT - Mercedes-Benz reaktiviert Abfindungsprogramm in Deutschland +++ China droht EU mit Gegenmassnahmen im Handelsstreit

en.title: BUSINESS NEWS - Mercedes-Benz reactivates severance program in Germany +++ China threatens EU with countermeasures in trade dispute
en.summary: Mercedes-Benz has reactivated a severance package program for employees in Germany. China has warned the EU of retaliatory measures in their ongoing trade conflict.
